messages:
maria: quick sync  prototype linked: https://www.figma.com/file/GHI789 - focusing on revoke/undo, batch rotate, and permission-request flows. need input on copy and keyboard/a11y.

sam: looked through frames. main ask: make the undo obvious. current small toast is easy to miss. propose a 12s undo banner with 'Restore' CTA and a small chevron for 'View audit'.

lee: accessibility: banner must be tabbable, announced with aria-live=assertive, and focusable action order: Restore -> View audit. modal opening focus should land on the modal title. for steppers, ensure tab order follows logical action progression.

anya: copy suggestion for revoke modal: replace "This action cannot be undone" with "This will revoke the key immediately. You can restore it within 14 days from the activity log." add inline link: "Permanently delete now" for advanced users. makes intent clearer.

oliver: security: for keys tagged 'system' or 'infrastructure' require stronger confirmation. prefer typing-to-confirm the key name for those. checkbox is ok for service account keys. also show a red banner: "System key: rotating/revoking may interrupt services."

sam: batch rotate UX: show collapsed "Impacted services (n) \u25be" summary per project, expandable. stream progress per key: spinner -> rotated / failed. map failures to friendly messages and include Retry. avoid raw error dumps.

maria: permission flow idea: when CTA is disabled for missing perms, show inline 'Request access' button that opens a prefilled request modal (key names, scope). reduces dead-end UX. microcopy options: "Request access" seems best.

lee: keyboard note: when requesting access via keyboard, focus should move to the first input of the request modal. ensure success confirmation is announced.

infra-bot: Deploy staged: feature/keys-ux/undo-access -> staging (build 495).

maria: plan: - standardize undo window to 14 days / toast 12s - revert copy to clarify Revoke vs Delete - add typing confirm for system keys - inline 'Request access' flow - collapsed impacted services summary. I'll update Figma and ping when mocks are updated. thanks all :raised_hands:
